priorFindingDisposition.evidence: Both raw layers reject repeated grant pairs with identical or conflicting scopes and repeated deny pairs; order reversal cannot change admission. Cross-layer deny duplication is lawful; a grant and deny of the same pair remains lawful and denies.

capDecision: Section 7.5 bounds retained HE-2 results by 64 MiB and each HE-1 stage by 16 MiB and its prebound byteCap; at most four single-use stage handles yield a conservative 128 MiB total scratch payload. Equal ceilings admit and over-ceiling refuses before the result reader. Actual physical integration and request lifetime remain the broker unit's review obligation.

import copy, hashlib, importlib.util, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
B=Path('docs/coop/completion').resolve()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('security_supplement_v4',B/'security_unit_lib_v4.py');L=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(L)
pair=json.loads((B/'security-fixtures.v4/permission-policy.effective.example.json').read_text())
checks=[]
def check(i,ok,detail=None):
 checks.append({'id':i,'pass':bool(ok),'detail':detail})
def run(i,g,p,want=None):
 for x in (g,p):
  if x is not None:L.validate(x,L.load_schema('permission-policy'))
 before=copy.deepcopy((g,p));e,errors=L.merge_policy(g,p)
 check(i,(not errors if want is None else want in errors and not e['grants']) and (g,p)==before,{'refusals':errors,'effectiveGrantCount':len(e['grants'])})
 return e
run('valid-narrowing',copy.deepcopy(pair['global']),copy.deepcopy(pair['project']))
for layer in ['global','project']:
 for conflicting in [False,True]:
  g,p=copy.deepcopy(pair['global']),copy.deepcopy(pair['project']);d=g if layer=='global' else p;dup=copy.deepcopy(d['grants'][0])
  if conflicting:dup['scope']['pathPrefixes']=['src/other']
  d['grants'].append(dup)
  for rev in [False,True]:
   if rev:d['grants'].reverse()
   run(f'{layer}-duplicate-grant-conflict-{conflicting}-reversed-{rev}',g,p,'POLICY.DUPLICATE_GRANT_PAIR')
 g,p=copy.deepcopy(pair['global']),copy.deepcopy(pair['project']);d=g if layer=='global' else p;deny={'stableId':d['grants'][0]['stableId'],'token':d['grants'][0]['token']};d['denies']=[deny,copy.deepcopy(deny)]
 run(layer+'-duplicate-deny',g,p,'POLICY.DUPLICATE_DENY_PAIR')
 g,p=copy.deepcopy(pair['global']),copy.deepcopy(pair['project']);d=g if layer=='global' else p;deny={'stableId':d['grants'][0]['stableId'],'token':d['grants'][0]['token']};d['denies'].append(deny)
 e=run(layer+'-grant-deny-pair-legal',g,p)
 check(layer+'-deny-wins',not any(x['stableId']==deny['stableId'] and x['token']==deny['token'] for x in e['grants']))
g,p=copy.deepcopy(pair['global']),copy.deepcopy(pair['project']);p['denies']=copy.deepcopy(g['denies']);run('cross-layer-deny-same-pair-legal',g,p)
# 64 MiB is the HE-2 retained-result aggregate, independently of HE-1 stage admission.
limit=16*1024*1024;aggregate=64*1024*1024;data=b'x'*limit;ref=L.make_result_ref(bytes(16),data)
for n in [0,3*limit,3*limit+1]:
 calls=[];ctx={'effectResult':{'effectOutcome':'COMPLETED','requestSeq':1,'resultRef':ref},'expectedRequestSeq':1,'scratchDirSt':{'type':'directory','uid':1000,'mode':0o700},'selfUid':1000,'fileSt':{'type':'regular','nlink':1,'uid':1000,'size':len(data)},'spawnBytesSoFar':n}
 def reader(r):calls.append(r);return data
 out,body=L.resolve_result(ref,reader,ctx)
 check('he2-retained-before-'+str(n),(out=='OK' and body==data and len(calls)==1) if n+limit<=aggregate else (out=='RESULT.SPAWN_CAP_EXCEEDED' and body is None and not calls),out)
for size in [limit,limit+1]:
 result=L.stage_file_admission({'type':'regular','nlink':1,'uid':1000,'mode':0o600,'size':size},1000,limit)
 check('he1-stage-size-'+str(size), result is None if size==limit else result is not None, result)
check('conservative-independent-budget',4*limit+aggregate==128*1024*1024)
Path('/tmp/security-policy-cap-supplement-probes.v1.json').write_text(json.dumps({'checks':checks,'summary':{'checks':len(checks),'failures':sum(not x['pass'] for x in checks)}},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'checks':len(checks),'failures':[c for c in checks if not c['pass']]},indent=2))
